event_chain.summary: Share pages missing noindex are indexed by search engines

summary: In July 2026 Reddit users found that conversations shared through Claude's share-link feature were indexed by Google and could be found with searches for site:claude.ai/share, because the share pages lacked a noindex tag. Thousands of shared conversations were findable, some containing cryptocurrency keys and legal inquiries, and user-created artifacts were also exposed. Anthropic had the pages removed from Google, though they stayed searchable on Bing and Brave for longer.
